title: The Last Gravity Revisited
author: August Eriksen
blurb: Lior Yarrow, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
